record.question: The earliest pathological change in diabetic nephropathy is:
record.explanation: Answer B: Glomerular basement membrane thickening. Glomerular basement membrane thickening is the earliest measurable ultrastructural lesion of diabetic nephropathy. On light microscopy, mesangial expansion may be the earliest visible change, so the question should specify the examination method. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK571720/; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sites/books/NBK279103/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
